title: Anthropic Donates Agent Skills Standard Used by 70 AI Platforms
summary:
The Agentic AI Foundation now controls the naming rights, logo, and technical infrastructure for the Agent Skills open standard. Anthropic transferred the asset's domain and GitHub organization to the nonprofit and proposed a new development roadmap including security guidance and versioned releases. More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated the standard since December 2025.

The framework originated as a technical experiment within the company's Claude Code tool before seeing wide industry adoption. This move follows a previous transfer by Anthropic, which donated the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to the same foundation to facilitate open development across the AI ecosystem.
